Well, the Godot 4.0 name changes are a POSITIVE step, in the right direction, it's far more user-friendly, but it creates an UNKNOWN problem, ie it makes the scene dock more unreadable . . I suggest instead of writing MeshInstance3D, the add node panel says MeshInstance ( 3D ), so it's clear when adding nodes, but doesn't change the name, or add +3D, in the scene dock, that would be very nice . . .

It would help, also consider changing MeshInstance, to 3DMeshNode, or MeshObject, Mesh3D, or PolygonMesh . . MeshObject, as a new user, I don't want to create an instance, of a prefab, just a 3DMesh, or a 3DObject . . Just saying, Godot 4.0 is better, than 3.2 in terms of names, by far, but the many +3D in the scene dock, makes all the nodes look the same, and I have to read the name twice, to see which one it is, a consequence of the new name-changes, that are VERY good, all the same . .

Thank you . .
